name: Australian Internet Company
summary: Sydney dialup ISP turned full-service IT provider (aic.net.au); operating from 1996, company ABN cancelled Nov 2020 though the site persists (THE AUSTRALIAN INTERNET COMPANY PTY. LTD., ACN 070 007 555).

events.details: The Australian Internet Company Pty Ltd, established 1996 (own site "Established since 1996", footer ©1996-2026); earliest Wayback capture 20 Dec 1996 (www.aic.net.au).
Company ABN 74 070 007 555 cancelled 6 Nov 2020 (per ABR); aic.net.au site nonetheless remained live afterward (still up 2026), so the retail ISP's effective end is uncertain.
